mentions.description: A desktop-only web app combining bookmark storage with a Hacker News-style news feed. Users can save their bookmarks and read the latest articles on tech, startups, and AI, described as "Pocket meets HN". Not mobile friendly yet.

mentions.name: fyp3.com
mentions.description: A social bookmarking site that blends link-sharing with a read-later service, with a Chrome extension to easily tag, save, and share pages. Its front page currently curates pages the builder finds interesting, focused on AI and startup topics.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A social bookmarking site: https://fyp3.com/

Kinda like HN meets Pocket.

It includes a Chrome extension to easily tag, save & share pages.
